result.title: Looming drives the giant fiber (von Reyn et al. 2014)
result.citation: von Reyn CR, Breads P, Peek MY, Zheng GZ, Williamson WR, Yee AL, Leonardo A, Card GM (2014) A spike-timing mechanism for action selection. Nature Neuroscience 17:962-970
result.read: abstract only (Europe PMC); the full text is behind a paywall and was not read

questions.prompt: You drive all 311 looming detectors (LPLC2 and LC4) for 2 s. What does the giant fiber DNp01 do, compared with driving 311 random other visual projection neurons?

verdict.basis: effect size and direction only: n = 4 is too few flies for the validation's p < 0.01 (the smallest one-sided Wilcoxon p at n = 4 is 0.0625)

questions.note: The wiring from the looming detectors to the giant fiber is strong enough to drive it: the premise of the paper's escape model holds in this connectome.

comparison.question: You drive all 311 looming detectors (LPLC2 and LC4) for 2 s. What does the giant fiber DNp01 do, compared with driving 311 random other visual projection neurons?
comparison.your_hypothesis: fires much more (at least 1.5x its calm rate)
